sentences.text: Sidney Haughton originally named the species Plateosaurus cullingworthi in 1924 based on a partial skeleton.
Friedrich von Huene reassessed the specimen in 1932 and placed it in the new genus Plateosauravus.
More than a dozen additional partial skeletons were discovered in Kruger National Park by game warden Adriaan Louw on March 27, 1995.
Plateosauravus belongs to the parent group Plateosauridae.
It is classified within the class Saurischia.
The time range for Plateosauravus is from the Norian to the Rhaetian, between 227.3 and 201.4 million years ago.
It is debated whether Plateosauravus should be classified as Euskelosaurus, which some researchers consider a nomen dubium based on undiagnostic material.
